CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Teachings on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Teachings on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings on Prayer.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   C. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Abrahamic Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.
   D. Use Abrahamic Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.

9. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   B. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   C. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Lost Sheep.
   B. Say The Lost Sheep has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Lost Sheep with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Lost Sheep to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Acts of Compassion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Family Relationships 6 6.2 Human Sexuality Responsible sexual behaviour 7 6.3 Sa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
